The National Account Manager is responsible for identifying, developing, and growing strategic national account opportunities across the Foodservice trade channel.

This role requires an experienced national accounts hunter with a proven track record of building, expanding, and maintaining customer relationships across a variety of foodservice segments, including QSR, fast casual, casual dining, family dining, hospitality, and emerging growth channels.

The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial discipline, customer insight, and cross-functional leadership to advance branded, custom, and exclusive fully cooked protein solutions from concept through commercialization, while delivering profitable growth, distribution expansion, and long-term customer value.

· Own and grow a portfolio of national foodservice accounts, with emphasis on strategic chains, emerging growth customers, and new business opportunities across the foodservice trade channel.
· Develop and execute customer-specific annual and multi-year business plans that deliver revenue, volume, margin, distribution, innovation, and profitability objectives.
· Identify, qualify, and advance new account opportunities by building a strong sales pipeline, leveraging customer insights, market trends, menu needs, and the company’s fully cooked protein cap

Location: US - Remote About SiTime SiTime is the Precision Timing company. Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments.

MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com .

Primary market segments include Aerospace & Defense, Communications, Enterprise & Datacenter, Consumer/Mobile-IoT and Industrial.

High personal accountability for results and progress. Very strong communication skills Developing rapport quickly, getting in and out of discussions quickly, management details without sacrificing ROI Resilience – the ability to overcome obstacles and difficult situations on a daily basis.

Curiosity – the ability to ask good, probing questions, actively seek out new information to validate or dispel existing assumptions. Location Our Channel Account Manager will be an integral part of our Sales team in EMEA. This role is based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands and Sweden. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation.

We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multi-cloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity The core mission of the Channel Account Manager is to cultivate and expand relationships with our key channel partners which include Distributors, Managed Services Providers, and Resellers. This role combines strategic relationship management and enablement responsibilities with outbound energy and partner development hustle.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for channel partners while simultaneously helping them identify and drive new opportunities for DoiT’s PartnerOps solutions, DoiT Cloud Intelligence, PerfectScale, Select, and Attribute — building the pipeline and partnerships that fuel DoiT's indirect channel growth.

Responsibilities Channel Partner Relationship Management
Serve as the dedicated relationship owner for channel partners, acting as their primary point of contact across commercial, technical, and operational matters.
Build and maintain deep, trusted relationships with key stakeholders at channel partners — including partner principals, channel managers, sales teams, and technical leads.
Conduct regular business reviews with channel partners to assess performance, align on pipeline, and identify growth opportunities.
Represent DoiT at partner events, industry conferences, and partner-hosted summits to strengthen brand presence and deepen relationships.
Pitch, Discovery & Pipeline Development
Lead compelling, confident introductory pitches of DoiT’s solutions to channel partner sales teams and their customers without requiring technical support in room.
Work with the channel partners on executing customer deal registration for DoiT’s solutions.
Work alongside the Channel Account Executive to track all customer deal registrations from the channel partner to move these opportunities from qualification through close.
Channel Strategy & Joint GTM
Develop and execute joint business plans with channel partners, setting clear revenue targets, milestones, and co-sell activities.
Influence channel partner roadmaps and go-to-market strategies to increase DoiT's share of wallet within their customer base.
Collaborate with DoiT's Marketing team on channel-specific campaigns, events and initiatives.
Monitor and report on channel market trends, competitive dynamics, and partner ecosystem developments to inform DoiT's channel strategy.
Partner Enablement
Work alongside DoiT’s Partner Success Team to design and deliver enablement programs equipping channel partner sales and technical teams to effectively position and sell DoiT solutions.
Support channel partners with the tools, materials, and knowledge they need to confidently position DoiT products in end-customer conversations.
Partner with Product and Marketing to develop channel-ready collateral, playbooks, and co-branded materials tailored to channel audiences.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Act as an advocate internally for channel partners — communicating partner needs, deal context, and escalation requests across the organization.
Provide structured feedback to leadership, Product, and GTM Strategy teams on partner performance, competitive intelligence, and market signals from the field.
Ensure clean deal registration, CRM accuracy, and pipeline hygiene across all partner-sourced opportunities.

7+ years of experience in channel sales, partner management, or indirect channel roles.
Proven ability to operate across both strategic partner management and outbound partner development within the same role or program.
Deep understanding of Reseller and MSP business models, channel economics, and the technology distribution landscape.
Strong knowledge of cloud channel programs and partner ecosystems across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
Proven ability to lead an initial product pitch and structured discovery conversation independently, without requiring technical support.
Experience working within FinOps, CloudOps, or cloud cost management domains is a significant advantage; curiosity and willingness to develop deep product knowledge is essential.
Excellent prospecting, relationship-building, communication, and executive presentation skills — equally comfortable opening cold conversations and running senior partner QBRs.
Highly organized with strong CRM discipline and the ability to manage a high volume of partner relationships and active pipeline simultaneously.
Self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and energized by building in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. Life assurance, employee assistance programme and many other benefits.

What will you get to do in this Mid-Market Benelux Senior Account Executive role? As a Senior Account Executive at HubSpot , you use inbound selling strategies to find new business and help them grow using HubSpot software. You benefit from inbound leads and partner with Business Development Reps to research prospects and create outreach strategies.

You run online demos of the HubSpot software and successfully sell the HubSpot value proposition. Your target clients will largely consist of small and mid-sized businesses. This position would be based out of your home office working in an inside sales model, and it is a full closing role.

We are actively hiring for a Senior Level Mid-Market Account Executive; candidates are eligible to be office, flex or remotely located in the Republic of Ireland based on individual preference! Please check out this article for more context: The Future of Work at HubSpot : How We're Building a Hybrid Company.

What are the responsibilities of a Mid-Market Benelux Senior Account Executive? In this role, you will get to:
Quickly identify challenges that our prospective customers face and discover the best inbound marketing solutions for their business
Consistently close new business at or above quota level
Nurture relationships with highly qualified opportunities at small and mid-sized companies
Build relationships with prospects and internal stakeholders to grow new business
Work collaboratively with HubSpot 's marketing and technology departments to evolve our sales strategy when new features and products are introduced
Help shape the future of HubSpot 's mission with your perspectives, ideas, and skills

Candidates must be based in the Ireland to be considered for a remote opportunity
3 years of Closing Sales experience

Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.
Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Junior Account Executive - Fintech (w/m/d) treibst Du unser Wachstum aktiv voran. Du gewinnst Solar- und Wärmepumpen-Installateure deutschlandweit als Partner, begleitest sie von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss und sorgst für ein reibungsloses Onboarding. Dabei zeigst Du, wie unsere Finanzierungsplattform Verkaufsabschlüsse vereinfacht und machst nachhaltige Energielösungen für mehr Menschen zugänglich.
Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Kooperationspartner in der PV- und Wärmepumpenbranche.
Du nimmst Kontakt zu Entscheidern auf: per Telefon, Mail oder LinkedIn.
Du begeisterst als erster Kontakt Installateure von unserer Absatzfinanzierung und klärst erste Fragen.
Du bist für den aktiven Aufbau deiner Sales-Pipeline verantwortlich und pflegst diese selbstständig.
Du aktualisierst und verwaltest alle Vertriebsaktivitäten, Leads und Kundeninformationen im CRM (Pipedrive).
Dein Profil
Erfahrung im B2B-Sales / Business Development (idealerweise Closing- & Prozessverantwortung, z. B. AE, Partner Sales, Key Account, BD).
Du bist stark in Kommunikation, Einwandbehandlung und Verhandlung und kannst Menschen klar durch Prozesse führen.
Hohe Eigenverantwortung: du managst dein Gebiet, deine Pipeline und deine Targets wie ein Unternehmer.
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen
Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.
Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.
Attraktive Vergütung : Fixgehalt + Performance-Bonus (klare Ziele, 100% Transparenz
Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.
Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.
Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.
Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.
Dein Extra-Boost - 29 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

Wir wollen die erste Anlaufstelle für den Autowechsel werden. Mit einer Kombination aus Technologie, Medien und tiefem Automotive-Wissen haben wir die Art und Weise, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen, inserieren und leasen, grundlegend verändert.
Was als einfache Bewertungsplattform begann, ist heute einer der größten Online Marktplätze für den Autowechsel in Europa. About Precoro
Precoro is an agentic procurement , AP and spend management platform.
Most mid-market finance teams find out what they spent after they spent it. Someone chases purchase orders over email, someone keys invoices into the ledger, and the Finance Director learns what a site committed several weeks after it committed it. The software built to fix that was designed for the Fortune 500: six-figure licences, rollouts measured in quarters, a consulting partner attached to the contract. Everyone below that line got left with spreadsheets.
We built Precoro for the companies underneath it. A £60m business with four sites gets the control a global one has , live in about three weeks, on the finance system it already runs: Sage, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics or Xero . Spend gets approved against budget before the money moves. Invoices reconcile against orders and receipts on their own. The CFO sees committed spend the day it is committed rather than at month end.
The AI work is the part we are most excited about, and it is where this category is heading. Agents raise and chase POs, route approvals to the right budget holder, read invoices and match them to orders and goods received. Procurement is close to an ideal case for it: the work is high volume, rule bound, and nobody enjoys doing it. Every hour absorbed is an hour a six-person finance team does not need to hire a seventh person to cover.
We started in 2015. More than 1,000 companies across 80 countries now run on the platform. Precoro already has customers in the UK: Paul Smith, Carwow, In The Style, Tymit - all of whom found us on their own, with no UK sales team behind them at all.
Now we're building one, and looking for the person to help lead that charge.
What you'll own
A curated list of top-tier UK account s, chosen for fit and live buying signals - yours to work
Full-cycle deals with Finance and Procurement leaders , from first outreach through demo to close
1:1 ABM, executive dinners, and a seat at industry events like The FD Show and UK Construction Week - real budget behind you to build relationships
The shape of the UK playbook itself: what messaging works, which triggers convert, how the motion should run - decisions the next AEs we hire will inherit from you
Room to grow well past this seat - as the UK team builds out, there's a real path into leading it

4+ years closing B2B SaaS , with real time spent building your own pipeline
A track record with Finance or Ops leaders at mid-market companies , and numbers you can walk through with confidence, quarter by quarter
A steady, repeatable approach to prospecting - how you build your lists, which signals or triggers you chase, and what you do to keep pipeline moving in a slow week
You've been the first rep in a market before, started out as an SDR or BDR, or already know procurement, P2P, or finance software
Why take this seat

About Native
Native is defining a new category in Cloud Security by empowering organizations to build truly secure-by-design environments. We provide a unified abstraction layer across AWS, Azure, and GCP, allowing security teams to seamlessly define and actively enforce policies without needing to master complex, cloud-specific configurations.

Founded by industry veterans from AWS and Dome9, backed by $42M in funding, and trusted by Fortune 100 enterprises, we are looking for exceptional talent to take extreme ownership and help us scale the future of multi-cloud security.
As Native 's Founding Federal Account Executive, you'll build and own our federal sales motion from the ground up - generating pipeline and closing strategic deals across U.S. federal agencies, including DoD, the Intelligence Community, and civilian departments.

This role is about building the federal program from zero - defining the strategy, processes, and foundations for long-term success . You'll be the first GTM hire dedicated to public sector and will serve as Native 's primary representative to federal customers, prospects, systems integrators, and channel partners
This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, knows how to navigate the realities of federal procurement, and understands how to land and expand inside agencies with long, complex buying cycles. You'll work directly with leadership, product, and technical teams to shape federal pricing, contract vehicle strategy, FedRAMP roadmap, partner ecosystem, and a repeatable federal sales playbook -turning early agency traction into durable, multi-year relationships.

Experience building and scaling a federal sales program from the ground up at an early-stage startup.

Deep working knowledge of federal procurement and contract vehicles - GSA Schedule, SEWP V/VI, CIO-SP3/4, ITES-SW2, OTAs, and agency-specific BPAs - and a track record of getting on the right paper to close business.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Field Sales Executive to join our Bristol & South West team. In this role, you’ll help us sign up the best restaurants across Bristol and the South West region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Regional UK & Ireland team, reporting to the Regional Manager. We are experts in the local markets we serve, and this role is all about being out on the road, finding hidden gems, and being the face of Deliveroo in the South West and Wales.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Strategic Prospecting: Map, prospect, pitch, and close new restaurants across your region, acting as a city-level expert who knows exactly which up-and-coming spots customers crave most.
Multi-channel Outreach: Communicate with restaurant owners through physical visits, calls, and digital platforms to demonstrate the value of Deliveroo’s technology.
Seamless Onboarding: Oversee the partner onboarding process from start to finish to ensure it is as quick, efficient, and seamless as possible.
Performance Monitoring: Ensure restaurant success within the critical first eight weeks of signing to guarantee long-term growth on the platform.
Community Immersion: Attend restaurant and food meet-ups and sample food from high-quality establishments to stay ahead of market trends.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Sales & Negotiation: Proven experience in targeting new business and the ability to structure win-win deals for both partners and Deliveroo.
Commercial Knowledge: A strong understanding of the economics of food delivery and the ability to work effectively towards demanding monthly targets.
Exceptional Communication: Confidence in building relationships face-to-face, over the phone, and via email with a wide range of stakeholders.
Operational Ownership: A tenacious, self-motivated approach to managing your own territory and taking full ownership of your results.

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.
What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Most of our growth so far has happened in England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are three separate health systems, each with its own clinical systems, procurement routes, information governance rules and digital strategy, and none of them have an ICB layer to sell into. This role owns all three.
It is a genuinely blank page. You work out what winning looks like in each nation, then build the repeatable way to do it, selling everything from a single practice subscription to a health board wide agreement.
Owning three health systems, not one region: building pipeline across Scottish and Welsh health boards, clusters, PCNs, GP federations and HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland, and adapting your approach to the structures that actually exist in each.
Selling at every level: running fast, high volume practice level deals alongside long, multi stakeholder board and national negotiations, and knowing which one you are in.
Winning the technical argument: these deals are frequently won or lost on integration. You will hold your own with eHealth teams, IG leads and national bodies on clinical systems, APIs, deployment routes and assurance, without waiting for an engineer to join the call.
Turning pilots into contracts: generating credible local evidence and then converting it into paid, scaled agreements rather than letting it stall as a permanent trial.
Using data to pick your battles: building the territory model from list sizes, usage, adoption and pipeline data, and using it to decide where a national deal is realistic and where practice by practice is the faster path.
Building the playbook: leaving behind documented, repeatable go to market approaches per nation, so this patch scales beyond you.

You are comfortable at both ends of the deal size range, equally credible on a quick practice level close and a twelve month, multi stakeholder board negotiation.

You are not put off by complexity, whether that is clinical systems, interoperability, deployment routes or information governance. You treat it as part of the sale, not someone else’s problem.
You are a strategic thinker who can build a territory plan from a blank page, defend the choices in it, and change it when the ground shifts.
You are data-led and at home in spreadsheets, CRM and reporting tools, able to turn complex information into clear priorities and a compelling pitch.
You are a self-starter who is energised rather than unnerved by an unmapped patch and no established playbook.
